_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 51: 4-17 February 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He asks about what is happening right now in New York and is told Congress is on recess until February 23rd 2026, they work out that it is next week, and he asks them to play what is going on in New York.
mentions.quote: Congress is on recess until February 23rd, 2026
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a published congressional calendar read out.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the church should start preaching Holy Ghost and fire in the pulpit, telling people Jesus Christ is coming and getting serious about their creator's return, and that this is serious stuff.
mentions.quote: start preaching Holy Ghost and fire in our pulpit
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says something starts inside you asking what is going on, that he does not want to become what he sees so much of and has been allowed to see because of the platform, and that he is not judging these men and women.
mentions.quote: I don't want to be what I have been allowed to see so much of
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the most direct thing he has said about what the platform has shown him of other ministries.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says God provided it and he will not complain out of his mouth, that it may not be what he wanted to eat but God provided something, and that the fear of the Lord does not complain but reverences him.
mentions.quote: The fear of the Lord doesn't complain
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it discourages the audience from voicing dissatisfaction with what arrives.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says people need to believe and think they are credible again because they have lost their credibility, that people and the world and not just the body of Christ are saying they are done, that they are seeing it, and asks what happens in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: they've lost their credibility. the world are saying, We're done
mentions.falsify_match: Measurable decline in church credibility.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is describing a present state rather than forecasting one.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is what he saw and what the Lord warned them about and that they are here, that it is time to wake up, asks what the rest of 2026 will be like and what they will see with the 250 years, and refers back to Red Dawn.
mentions.quote: This is what the Lord warned us about. We're here
mentions.falsify_match: The red dawn scenario arriving.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. We are here converts a forecast into a description of the present, which is the move to watch.

mentions.claim_text: He lifts up the body and gives thanks for the time of prayer and for seeking God, and says they are thankful for where they are in these end times.
mentions.quote: We're so thankful for where we are in these end times
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He declares against the agenda of 2030 that they will not bow their knee to it, that they stand firm in the name of Jesus and call those things that be not as though they were, and that this nation is rising up.
mentions.quote: AGENDA 2030. WE WILL NOT BOW OUR KNEE TO THAT
mentions.falsify_match: The programme stalling.
mentions.falsify_miss: It proceeds, which he later says is inevitable anyway.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for a mighty red wave, says not a political red wave but a blood wave, a glory wave, a glory of the Lord wave concerning 2026, and that they will not go into 2026 as status quo but as a blood bought and redeemed church.
mentions.quote: not a political red wave, but a blood wave, a glory wave
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and worth noting the move: red wave is here reinterpreted from an electoral result into a spiritual one, which would let a lost midterm still count.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He tells them to speak it out of their mouth and say it, that this is the word he is believing for, and says he may not always know the street address as he calls it but he knows the sentences, and that he believes with all his heart this is the word.
mentions.quote: I may not always know the street address. But I know the sentences
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is his clearest statement of what he claims accuracy for: the content but not the specifics.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the number three, that the Lord kept talking to him about February and about these things, and that he knew it had something to do with the Olympics.
mentions.quote: I saw the number three and the Lord kept talking to me about February
mentions.falsify_match: Something at the Olympics connected to the third.
mentions.falsify_miss: The games pass without it. Told after 3 February had already gone by.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether they belong to him and whether he knows them, notes they may know a lot about him but asks whether he knows them, and speaks of going from glory to glory as he changes them into the glorious church.
mentions.quote: You may know a lot about him, but does he know you?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays that when they do the national day of prayer in May he calls a Holy Ghost sound of a mighty rushing wind, citing that if his people called by his name humble themselves and pray and turn from their wicked ways then they will hear from heaven.
mentions.quote: when we do our national day of prayer, Lord, on May
mentions.falsify_match: A visible outpouring at the May national day of prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The condition means any absence is attributed to insufficient humbling.

mentions.claim_text: He prays in this valley of decision over the one nation under God, calls a divine reversal twice, and declares they will remain a sheep nation and not be a goat nation, calling those things that be not as though they were.
mentions.quote: We will remain a sheep nation. We will not be a goat nation
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the sheep and goat sorting is at the judgment, not in history.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees 2026 highlighted and 2027 and he sees storms, but that out of it is like a parting of the storm with the glory of the Lord shining through, and that they must contend for it and cannot be lazy, pushing back the demonic.
mentions.quote: I see out of it is like a parting of the storm
mentions.falsify_match: Storms followed by a visible revival.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Contend and do not be lazy put any failure on the audience.

mentions.claim_text: He says it only delays the inevitable, that Agenda 2030 will come to full fruition, that it is the beast system and the demonic agenda of the beast system, that he sees the occultic, and that as he is exposing the Epsteins and all this darkness is coming out.
mentions.quote: It only delays the inevitable. Agenda 2030 will come to full fruition
mentions.falsify_match: The programme reaching full implementation by 2030.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Worth marking: he says outright that prayer only delays it, which concedes the intercession cannot prevent the outcome he asks them to pray against.

mentions.claim_text: He declares a backbone and says they have one more round of a blessing and increase, holding back the 2030 agenda, warns that if they do not do this then, and says by the spirit of God he sees the storm on the shoreline.
mentions.quote: we have one more round of a blessing and increase
mentions.falsify_match: A final period of prosperity before the storm lands.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. One more round is the same structure as a window not a door: the good period is finite and unrepeatable.

mentions.claim_text: He breaks every plot, every plan and every demonic stronghold of ideas and ideology in the name of Jesus, declaring they fall at their feet and that every demonic assignment against this life will fall at their feet.
mentions.quote: Every demonic assignment against this life will fall at our feet
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says these ceremonies are circling around these events, names the Super Bowl, says it is the Illuminati and the Agenda 2030 circling around the Olympics opening and the closing ceremony and the whole Super Bowl.
mentions.quote: It's the Illuminati. It's the Agenda 2030 circling around the Olympics opening
mentions.falsify_match: Occult symbolism identified in the ceremonies, which is a reading rather than an event.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing happens at either. The claim is about meaning rather than about occurrence, so it cannot fail.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all going down the rapids, that he told them 2026 would be rapids and turbulent, and that it is in front of the banks as they fight because they want what is theirs and are attacking it, recalling the vision he showed them weeks back.
mentions.quote: I told you 2026 would be a rapids. Turbulent
mentions.falsify_match: A turbulent year for the banking and crypto sectors.
mentions.falsify_miss: A calm one. Rapids adds an image to turbulence without adding a threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him 2026 will be rapids and they will try to bring it all, and that they will have one man at the table who brings an agreement between the two, one man who will have the answers, and that he looked like Jared Kushner.
mentions.quote: One man will have the answers. He looked like Jared Kushner
mentions.falsify_match: A named individual brokering a banking and crypto settlement in 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such broker. He hedges the identification with looked like rather than asserting it, which is the honest version.

mentions.claim_text: He says they shine brighter and get more views than the bunny, that the bunny is going away, that he cannot use the other word, jokes that the bunny will be mounted on their fireplace, and that the other is rising up in Jesus' name.
mentions.quote: We shine brighter and get more views than the bunny
mentions.falsify_match: The named brand declining while the channel grows, both of which are countable.
mentions.falsify_miss: The reverse. Who the bunny is is not spelled out, only gestured at.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that the righteous rise up with a backbone like a crowbar and take the land for Jesus, that all to Jesus they surrender and humbly bow, and thanks God that he is not done with America yet.
mentions.quote: the righteous rise up with a BACKBONE LIKE A CROWBAR
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he never saw a volcano this time, that he said a great shaking is coming to Italy but it was not in this word, asks them to play it, and describes the number three highlighted to him in purple on a mountaintop.
mentions.quote: The number three was highlighted to me in purple and it was on a mountaintop
mentions.falsify_match: Something in Italy connected to the third.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Worth crediting: he separates what was in the word from what was not, and says the volcano was not in this one.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions the squad and that girl from the squad, says it concerns corruption, that people are fed up and want to replace her and it is time for her to go, and that he sees the bees, big black hornlike bumblebees.
mentions.quote: That girl from the squad. It's concerning corruption
mentions.falsify_match: The woman losing office.
mentions.falsify_miss: She does not. Seventh telling and still no name, though the squad narrows it to a handful of people.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the bees coming up out of the land where there are beautiful flowers and green and circling this woman's head, and mentions political theatre that will really take off.
mentions.quote: the bees are coming up out of the land and they're circling this woman's head
mentions.falsify_match: See the removal claim it belongs to.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says it will come, repeated, November through great prayer from their chair and their seat of authority, that they have a lot to lose and should not let pride stand in the way, and that distractions are to come all throughout the year.
mentions.quote: November through great prayer from your seat of authority
mentions.falsify_match: The November result going their way.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not, which the prayer clause converts into insufficient prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not understand what he was seeing concerning the three, but that the Lord said February 3rd would be a stench to him, that there is something about it, and that it will be a stench concerning decisions that will be made.
mentions.quote: the Lord said February 3rd would be a stench to me
mentions.falsify_match: Decisions made on 3 February 2026 that he would find repellent.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes without them. Said the day after it passed, and he still says he does not understand what he was seeing.
